ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: gucefCOMPUTE bridge plugin that adds multi-core and accelerator providers to the gucefMATH batch kernels
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: Registers the compute kernel declarations and CPU kernels of the MATH batch kernels with gucefCOMPUTE and the MULTICORE (CPU backend, fork-join) and ACCELERATOR (best device) providers with the gucefMATH batch dispatch table. gucefMATH does not depend on gucefCOMPUTE: this plugin depends on both.
